Authorized Dealer Portal

Muscle Concrete Dealer Pricing Portal

Built for authorized dealers to quote projects quickly and consistently. Grid-based pricing uses interpolation between surrounding sizes when a dimension falls between table values. Supports up to 4 separate lean-tos. Grand total rounds up to the next $50.

Dealer-ready quote tool Lean-to pricing aligned Fast quote workflow
1. Main Building
Main building uses the selected price book. 6" addition is a separate add-on.
Reinforcement
2. Lean-To(s)
Up to 4 separate lean-tos can be priced.
3. Add-Ons
4. Travel & Tax
Travel uses live ZIP geocoding and routing when internet is available. Tax uses a ZIP-triggered lookup with built-in fallback rates for consistency. Deposit is based on subtotal only and excludes tax and travel.
